channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Trump's political threat to 'decertify' thousands of Canadian-made aircraft risks aviation safety, industry watchers say
item.description: Trump's threat to "decertify" Canadian aircraft has stirred safety concerns among analysts who caution against politicizing aircraft certification.

item.title: Elon Musk discussed plans to party with Jeffrey Epstein on his Caribbean island, newly released emails show
item.description: Elon Musk planned visits to Jeffrey Epstein's island, DOJ emails show. Epstein repeatedly sought meetings with Musk, who previously denied visiting.

item.title: The most unexpected revelations and cameos in Melania Trump's documentary
item.description: Melania Trump starred in and produced her self-titled documentary about the days leading up to Donald Trump's 2025 inauguration.

item.title: Bill Gates denies allegations after Epstein email about 'trysts' and an STD is released
item.description: A recently released email suggests that Bill Gates had asked for antibiotics to "surreptitiously" give to his now ex-wife, Melinda.

item.title: Costco and Nike spark a frenzy with surprise sneaker drop
item.description: Nike and Costco teamed up to release Kirkland Signature SB Dunk Lows, causing hype at select US stores and sending resale prices soaring.

item.title: The Senate just voted to fund the government — but it'll still partially shut down for a few days anyway
item.description: While the Senate advanced a package of spending bills, the House won't be back in town to vote until late Monday.

item.title: Ex-CNN anchor Don Lemon released after arrest in Los Angeles, says he 'will not be silenced'
item.description: Don Lemon has said he was reporting on the protest as a journalist. His lawyer called the arrest an "attack on the First Amendment."

item.title: Protests against ICE take place across the US for 'National Shutdown'
item.description: Protesters across the nation participated in a general strike on Friday, demonstrating against ICE presence in some cities.

item.title: Kathy Ruemmler, now Goldman Sachs' top lawyer, thanked 'Uncle Jeffrey' Epstein for gifts, emails show
item.description: Ruemmler, who is now Goldman Sachs' top lawyer, says her association with Epstein was professional.

item.title: Trump taps a longtime agency economist as the next Bureau of Labor Statistics commissioner
item.description: Brett Matsumoto, who has been with the BLS for over 10 years, may end the monthslong search for a new commissioner after Trump fired the last one.
